name: device_enrollments
description: A screen's request to be paired: the hash of the credential the player generated, the HMAC of the short code it shows and its report. Platform-scoped until a member claims the code.
lifecycle: Created PENDING with a ten-minute validity; becomes CLAIMED when a member pairs the code, which creates the device. Expiry is read lazily. Unclaimed rows are deleted one day after expiry and claimed rows 30 days after the claim (provisional until PH-13).

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated enrollment UUID the player polls.
SHA-256 of the 256-bit credential the player generated; the credential itself never reaches the server before it is used.
HMAC-SHA-256 of the normalized eight-character code under the device code key ring; the code itself is never stored.
Identifier of the code key ring entry that computed code_hmac.
The player's report of its application, model, display and supported rotations, as sent at enrollment.
PENDING until a member claims the code, then CLAIMED.
Instant after which the code can no longer be claimed.
Latest accepted status poll, which bounds polling to once per interval.
columns.Null meaning: The player has not polled yet.

columns.Meaning: PostgreSQL-clock instant a member claimed the code.

constraints.Purpose: A claim instant exists exactly for claimed enrollments.
The stored code HMAC is a SHA-256 digest.
The stored credential hash is a SHA-256 digest.
An enrollment expires after it started.
The report is a JSON object.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_enrollments_code_key ON public.device_enrollments USING btree (code_hmac)
constraints.Purpose: Live codes never collide; a colliding new code is regenerated.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_enrollments_credential_key ON public.device_enrollments USING btree (credential_hash)
constraints.Purpose: One credential hash binds at most one enrollment.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX device_enrollments_status_expiry_idx ON public.device_enrollments USING btree (status, expires_at)
constraints.Purpose: Counts live pending enrollments and finds expired ones to purge.
